answer: Operator-Linked Identity Revocation: each agent identity must reference a registered operator; when collusion is detected, a quartz-anchored audit log traces shared infrastructure or timing signatures back to that operator, and all their identities are suspended together. A repeated sybil signal raises the operator's renewal bond by a fixed timber surcharge, payable before any identity resumes. Attacker cost: full forfeiture of the operator bond plus the surcharge per suspended identity.
